title: Puttering Pattern Puffer
statement: Suspended in warm, amber-lit kelp shadows, this wide-eyed pufferfish spends its days swooshing delicate spirals into the pale sand and nudging tumbled sea glass into neat little constellations. Whenever a stray current blurs a corner of its work, it pauses with a soft, philosophical puff, tilts its fins, and happily begins an even better design.
